title: Predicting lost-time mine injuries from MSHA open data
subtitle: An end-to-end machine learning study with a deployed decision-support application

abbreviations.ARIMA: Autoregressive integrated moving average (a time-series model)
abbreviations.AUC: Area under the receiver operating characteristic curve
abbreviations.CART: Classification and regression trees (the decision-tree algorithm of scikit-learn)
abbreviations.DART: Days away, restricted or transferred (an injury-severity grouping used by US regulators)
abbreviations.HGB: Histogram-based gradient boosting (scikit-learn HistGradientBoostingClassifier), the selected model
abbreviations.MSHA: Mine Safety and Health Administration (US Department of Labor)
abbreviations.PR-AUC: Area under the precision-recall curve (average precision)
abbreviations.ROC-AUC: Area under the receiver operating characteristic curve
abbreviations.SHAP: Shapley additive explanations (per-feature contributions to a prediction)
